locator.section: 8 / Detailed Mechanisms of Ion Fragmentation (remote-group interactions in the steroid molecular ion; Longevialle 1984, 1987)

evidence.curator_note: Step 1 of Equation 8.21, the 'gamma-H/beta-cleavage rearrangement of the 3-acetamido group' (text names it verbatim). The 3-(N-methylacetamido) steroid molecular ion undergoes a concerted McLafferty-type retro-ene: the amide carbonyl O (map2) abstracts the gamma-H (map12) borne by the ring carbon C2 (map7), the C=O pi shifts to C=N, and the amide N4-C3(ring, map6) bond is beta-cleaved, generating a ring C2=C3 double bond (map6=map7) and expelling the neutral enol of N-methylacetamide, H3C-C(OH)=N-CH3 (maps 1,2,3,4,5,12). ARC COUNT (convention D): the book draws 3 curved arcs on the acetamido group and all three are full (double-barbed) two-electron arrows -- (i) the C2-H12 bond curving to the carbonyl O (H transfer, encoded move 1: bond(7,12)->bond(2,12)); (ii) the N4-C6 amide bond curving up to form the ring C2=C3 double bond (beta-cleavage, encoded move 2: bond(4,6)->bond(6,7)); (iii) the C1=O2 pi curving to the C1-N4 bond to form C1=N4 of the enol (encoded move 3: bond(1,2)->bond(1,4)). All three moves are drawn; none is implicit. CHARGE/RADICAL (convention B): the book draws the reactant only as a bracketed [M]+. with the +. on the whole molecule and does NOT localize it; this record localizes the charge and odd electron on the remote 20-amino nitrogen (map27, drawn -CH2-NH2, n-ionized to the aminium radical cation -CH2-NH2+.), because that is the lowest-IE site and it is required to produce the alpha-cleavage drawn later on the same page (Eq 8.21 step 3 / record IMS8-EQ8.21b). Consequently the acetamido rearrangement here is an even-electron process on the neutral, remote portion of the radical cation -- hence three 2-electron arrows, no fishhooks. SUBSTRATE (convention F): the book does not name the exact steroid (only '3-acetamido' and '20-amino' on an androstane/gonane skeleton, from Longevialle 1984/1987); this record instantiates 3-(N-methylacetamido)-20-aminomethyl-androstane (flat, stereochemistry omitted; C23H40N2O+., m/z 360.3130), a curator-chosen realization of the drawn skeleton. This is a molecular-ion rearrangement (ion-neutral / ion-dipole complex chemistry); the enol 'remains in the vicinity of the ion' as an ion-neutral complex rather than separating -- hence both fragments are grouped in one product state and no fragment m/z is printed for this step.
